notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat using the Human token instead.
